spec.why: Rename the displayed product to Wukong and command to wukong, retaining internal @treadle packages, treadle/ workspace, formats and existing service/project identity. The user will rename the repository separately.

requirements.text: Public branding, CLI executable and live usage docs say Wukong/wukong.
Existing server state/enrollment and format contracts survive; authored skills remain brand-neutral and hook recall uses the installed runtime or explicit HARNESS_CLI override.
Rebranding helper changes display/CLI only, validates inputs before writing and supports repeated renames without package/import churn.
Repository gates, standalone runtime, generated host packages and independent PACK review pass. No invented new native host trust/activation or changes to closed records.

stories.text: As a harness user I want the product and CLI called Wukong while existing projects and workflows keep working.

out_of_scope: Renaming the remote repository, internal packages/workspace, stored formats, closed evidence or unrun real host acceptance; automatic Finish consent

decisions.decision: Use Wukong/wukong publicly, retain internal packages/workspace and service state identity, refresh owned skills/hooks through the installer.
decisions.because: Actual user authorization follows the proposed bounded product/CLI rename; avoid lost enrollments or import churn.

designs.title: Compatible product rebrand
designs.detail: Change brand tokens and CLI bin metadata while retaining internal names and a stable brand.stateDirectory token. Replace project-page literal command text with server-supplied public branding rendered with textContent. Recall uses its versioned runtime pointer and explicit override, refusing missing runtime rather than guessing a product binary. Repair brand:set to update tokens/current CLI bin only, supporting quoting and repeated renames. Brand gate scans current and former product tokens but allows internal import specifiers, workspace paths and historical contracts. Current README/agent instructions/installation/rebrand guide explain transition; historical specs, corpus, wiki research and frozen guide bytes remain preserved. Keep repository URLs valid until the user actually renames the repository.
